# Pitlane 0.5.5

More reliable missions, optional YOLO mode, and attachments for Maestro.

- Choose YOLO when starting a mission to let Pitlane answer supported approval requests automatically. Existing missions keep their original approval policy.
- New missions enable automatic model selection by default. Maestro can split independent work across agents and choose an available model for each task.
- Attach documents and images with the **+** button between Freechat and the model selector. Includes CSV compatibility on Windows and support for valid JPEG files with trailing whitespace.
- Recover from failed checks and review feedback in YOLO with bounded repair attempts, fresh checks, and another review. Independent agents can continue while a task is repaired.
- Retry temporary Codex model-capacity errors with bounded delays, preserving the selected model and mission context.
- Fix multiline approval commands, long Windows worktree paths, false file-ownership failures caused by line endings, and project scans that included generated artifacts.

Windows x64. Validated locally with authenticated Codex; authenticated Claude/Gemini execution and installation on a clean Windows system remain outside this validation.
